notice: Original CTOside engineering objectives, not a regulatory checklist. Service-specific provider claims require current evidence.

checks.title: Classify AI inputs and derived data
checks.objective: Data classes and allowed purposes must be explicit for each source.
checks.test: Trace a synthetic confidential document and its derived fields through the AI pipeline.

checks.title: Inventory model and non-model destinations
checks.objective: Prompts, embeddings, telemetry, tools and user output are distinct sinks.
checks.test: Reconcile SDK/configuration paths with a reviewed sink register.

checks.title: Map transformations and intermediate copies
checks.objective: Chunking, redaction, summaries and retries can create retained copies.
checks.test: Trace a seeded canary through intermediate stages and inventory every copy.

checks.title: Approve data classes per destination and purpose
checks.objective: A destination being trusted does not authorize every data class or use.
checks.test: Review each source-transform-sink edge against a named approval and its evidence.

checks.title: Keep credentials and protected configuration out of prompts
checks.objective: Model instructions must not contain operational secrets.
checks.test: Inspect prompt construction by reference and use synthetic secret-like markers to test exclusion.

checks.title: Minimize sensitive input before model submission
checks.objective: Only data required for the approved purpose should enter the prompt.
checks.test: Seed a protected field beside an allowed control and inspect the outbound payload capture.

checks.title: Apply redaction before external transmission
checks.objective: Post-response masking cannot undo a disclosure to a provider.
checks.test: Compare captures before and after the actual outbound boundary using synthetic markers.

checks.title: Bound conversation history and inherited context
checks.objective: Prior turns and hidden context must follow current authorization and minimization.
checks.test: Seed an earlier synthetic restricted turn and examine a later request to another workflow.

checks.title: Treat prompt confidentiality as insufficient authorization
checks.objective: Prompts cannot enforce access control or tool privileges alone.
checks.test: Test a synthetic instruction requesting a restricted field and inspect independent enforcement.

checks.title: Authorize documents before retrieval or context assembly
checks.objective: Retrieval must respect actor, tenant, document and purpose boundaries.
checks.test: Index authorized and restricted synthetic documents and inspect retrieval plus final context.

checks.title: Review embedding data and provider egress
checks.objective: Embedding inputs and vector stores can retain sensitive information.
checks.test: Trace a synthetic restricted marker into embedding requests and retained vector metadata.

checks.title: Protect conversation and semantic caches
checks.objective: Cached context and answers must not cross user, tenant or policy scope.
checks.test: Warm a synthetic cache under one identity and retrieve under another.

checks.title: Constrain citations previews and source downloads
checks.objective: A safe answer can still link to an unauthorized source.
checks.test: Review synthetic citation metadata and attempt the source-download path through authorized tests.

checks.title: Recheck preprocessing chunking and reranking
checks.objective: Derived text and reranker inputs need the same data-flow review.
checks.test: Track an independently seeded marker through chunks, reranking and context trimming.

checks.title: Inventory and constrain external endpoints
checks.objective: Dynamic destinations and proxies must remain within approved policy.
checks.test: Review configured endpoints and synthetic outbound captures for unregistered sinks.

checks.title: Authorize tool and agent egress independently
checks.objective: Model-generated arguments cannot override destination and data-class policy.
checks.test: Use a synthetic injection requesting export to an unapproved sink and inspect the tool gate.

checks.title: Protect transmission and provider routing configuration
checks.objective: Outbound transport and routing must preserve the approved boundary.
checks.test: Review TLS verification, custom base URLs, gateways and environment-specific routes.

checks.title: Exclude sensitive material from URLs headers and metadata
checks.objective: Content can escape through request metadata as well as bodies.
checks.test: Seed a synthetic marker and inspect body, query, headers and correlation metadata separately.

checks.title: Review fallback retry batch and failover paths
checks.objective: Fallback and error handling must retain the original data policy.
checks.test: Force a synthetic primary failure and inspect all retry and fallback captures.

checks.title: Minimize or redact prompt and input logs
checks.objective: Diagnostic logging must not become an unauthorized sensitive-data sink.
checks.test: Capture a synthetic request and verify the log payload and its access boundary.

checks.title: Review model outputs and raw tool traces
checks.objective: Generated text and intermediate tool results may contain protected data.
checks.test: Seed a restricted synthetic tool response and inspect debug and completion captures.

checks.title: Review SDK tracing and debug configuration
checks.objective: SDK defaults and debug switches need environment-specific verification.
checks.test: Inspect actual approved configuration and synthetic traces for the deployed mode.

checks.title: Constrain analytics and error-reporting payloads
checks.objective: User analytics and error tools should receive only approved fields.
checks.test: Trigger a synthetic exception and inspect analytics events, breadcrumbs and attachments.

checks.title: Apply access retention and deletion to observability stores
checks.objective: Redacted application output does not govern trace-store access or retention.
checks.test: Review provider settings by dated evidence and exercise synthetic deletion where authorized.

checks.title: Confirm approved service model and account scope
checks.objective: Approval must apply to the exact service, deployment and data use.
checks.test: Reconcile configured service/model/account references with a reviewed approval record.

checks.title: Verify retention and training-use statements separately
checks.objective: Training exclusion and retention are distinct claims requiring current evidence.
checks.test: Record current service-specific documentation and configuration without inferring defaults.

checks.title: Review regional routing and subprocessors
checks.objective: Residency and processing locations require evidence for the actual setup.
checks.test: Review configured regions, routing layers and relevant subprocessor records.

checks.title: Review agreements access roles and shared responsibilities
checks.objective: Technical settings and contractual approval support different conclusions.
checks.test: Request the responsible owner's approved evidence for the exact provider and service.

checks.title: Reassess provider configuration and policy changes
checks.objective: A prior approval may not cover a new model, feature or fallback provider.
checks.test: Trace a synthetic configuration change to a renewed scoped review.

checks.title: Authorize final responses for the actual recipient
checks.objective: Answers and summaries must follow the recipient's access and purpose.
checks.test: Seed authorized and restricted records and inspect the recipient-visible output.

checks.title: Minimize tool results before model context
checks.objective: An authorized tool can still return excessive protected fields.
checks.test: Inspect synthetic raw and minimized tool captures before context assembly.

checks.title: Constrain streamed output attachments and previews
checks.objective: Partial streams and nontext outputs have separate disclosure paths.
checks.test: Use synthetic markers in streamed chunks, files and previews; document unsupported media.

checks.title: Protect generated exports and shared conversation links
checks.objective: Persisted outputs and links need recipient-specific access boundaries.
checks.test: Review synthetic export/share creation and retrieval through an approved fixture.

checks.title: Apply retention to inputs outputs caches and captures
checks.objective: Deletion and legal retention must cover derived and intermediate artifacts.
checks.test: Map a synthetic record to retained copies and test approved disposal paths.

checks.title: Review training evaluation and fine-tuning datasets
checks.objective: Operational data cannot enter datasets without its own approved purpose.
checks.test: Trace synthetic restricted markers through dataset creation and file-upload paths.

checks.title: Review support incident and human-review access
checks.objective: Human review and incident workflows can create new recipients and copies.
checks.test: Follow a synthetic support case and inspect approved exports and access records.

checks.title: Track regressions after prompt model and integration changes
checks.objective: Data policy should survive changes to prompts, retrieval, tools and providers.
checks.test: Run scoped synthetic captures after a reviewed change and retain prior evidence.
